plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full tablerose system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the discovery page, testing the search widget and trending links to reach the results page. From there, it will drill into a specific restaurant to test the detail tabs and booking card. Finally, it will walk through the multi-step checkout flow (guest details, payment hold) to the confirmation page, checking form validations and interactive elements along the way.
assumptions: The search widget on index.html routes to restaurants.html or updates state.
Selecting a time slot on restaurants.html or restaurant.html initiates the booking flow to guest.html.
The checkout flow is linear: guest.html -> payment.html -> confirmation.html.
risk_hotspots: Search card inputs (autocomplete, date picker) on index.html
Filter rail and sort dropdown on restaurants.html
Sticky booking card and disabled time slots on restaurant.html
Form validation and dynamic totals/add-ons on payment.html
Small tap targets noted across the navigation and filter lists

phases.title: Discovery & Search
phases.objective: Validate the hero search widget and navigation to search results.
key_checks: Interact with WHERE, PARTY, DATE, and TIME inputs.
Click 'Find tables' to ensure transition to results.
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to restaurants.html via search or quick links.

phases.title: Results Filtering & Details
phases.objective: Evaluate the results page filters and restaurant detail view.
key_checks: Toggle various filters (Cuisine, Price, Neighborhood) and Sort dropdown on restaurants.html.
Click a restaurant card or time slot to enter restaurant.html.
Switch between tabs (Overview, Menu, Photos, Reviews) on restaurant.html.
Interact with the right-side sticky booking card.
exit_criteria: Tabs on detail page exercised and a specific time slot selected to start booking.

phases.title: Guest Details Form
phases.objective: Validate the first step of the checkout flow.
key_checks: Fill out standard text inputs (Name, Phone, Email).
exit_criteria: Form completed and navigated to payment.html.

phases.title: Payment & Confirmation
phases.objective: Validate the payment form, add-ons, and success state.
key_checks: Fill out card details and toggle add-ons (Cake, Rose), noting if totals update.
Submit the hold to reach confirmation.html.
Verify 'Modify' or 'Cancel' actions and calendar export buttons on confirmation.
exit_criteria: Reached confirmation.html and verified post-booking actions.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness
phases.objective: Ensure core booking flow is usable on smaller viewports.
key_checks: Check how the search widget collapses on index.html.
Verify the sticky booking card behavior on restaurant.html (does it become a bottom sheet?).
Ensure form inputs on payment.html remain accessible.
exit_criteria: Critical path verified on mobile viewport without major layout breakage.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise search inputs, filters, detail tabs, and all form controls in the booking flow.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the search and checkout flow on mobile to check responsive layouts.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets, particularly on mobile viewports.
